name: Icon Stat
description: Publish and browse verified Geometry Dash icon collections from player profiles.

publish.name: Publish My Icon Collection
publish.description: Allows authenticated uploads. Turning this off does not delete already published data; use Delete Published Data.

auto-sync.name: Automatically Synchronize
auto-sync.description: Synchronize once when Geometry Dash opens. Disable this to use only the manual Synchronize Now button.

sync-new-icons.name: Sync Newly Unlocked Icons
sync-new-icons.description: Automatically publish collection changes shortly after you unlock an icon. Failed attempts retry after a short delay.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.description: HTTPS base URL for your deployed Cloudflare Worker.
